seo.title: Massage near Montgomery, NY | Golden Practice
seo.description: Licensed massage serving Montgomery, NY — about 20 min from Brooklyn via Route 211. Transparent pricing, open every day.

richText.body: From the historic Village of Montgomery, Route 211 leads to us in about twenty minutes — a pleasant drive along the Wallkill that ends, fittingly, in a calm and unhurried treatment. It's a favorite reset for folks who like to make an outing of it.
